outputs.explanation: This panel shows a single representative spatial transcriptomics image with cluster annotations from one lung section. No statistical comparison across replicates is presented, so replicate reporting is not applicable.
H&E image and manual region annotation of the same single section shown in A; this is a representative/descriptive image, not replicated quantitative data.
Spatial expression overlays are shown for the same single representative section; no replicate quantification is being reported here.

replicate_statements: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) from T11b-high versus low squamous tumors (S1&S2 versus S3)
statistical significance was determined by bootstrapping with 1000 permutations
outputs.explanation: The GSEA compares two groups of spatial spots (S1&S2 vs S3) and reports a permutation-based statistical method, but the caption never states how many spots, sections, or animals underlie each group (the S1-S3 regions come from the single section shown in A-C). Without this, the number and type of replicates behind the comparison cannot be determined.

replicate_statements: Bar graph representing top squamous genes/oncogenes from differential gene expression (DEG) analysis of Tmprss11b-high versus low LUSC spatial transcriptomics data.

Differential gene expression was calculated using Seurat's FindAllMarkers function, and direct comparisons between two classes and corresponding P values were obtained using Seurat's FindMarkers function with the Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni P value correction.
outputs.explanation: P-values from a Wilcoxon rank-sum test imply a comparison across multiple units (e.g., spatial spots) between Tmprss11b-high and -low regions, but the caption does not state how many spots/replicates or biological samples were compared, nor the type of replicate (technical spots vs. biological sections/animals).
